page_title: ATA 4-1 LEC | Atalanta v Lecce 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' A precise low pass is received by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
89' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) has a goal ruled out for offside!
88' A quickly taken corner by Lecce.
88' The referee blows his whistle, Lecce are awarded a corner kick. A pass into the penalty area from Konan Ndri (Lecce) is intercepted by the defence.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch for Nicola Zalewski.
82' 4 - 1 Brilliant finish! Konan Ndri (Lecce) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Danilo Veiga, then produced a nice strike into the top left corner. The score is 4:1.
79' Substitution. Jamil Siebert leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tiago Gabriel (Lecce).
75' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Marten de Roon will be replaced by Yunus Musah (Atalanta).
75' Kamaldeen Sulemana goes off the pitch and Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) comes on.
75' Charles De Ketelaere comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).

73' 4 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 4:0.
73' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
71' Here is a change. Christ-Owen Kouassi is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Danilo Veiga (Lecce).
71' It is time for a substitution. Francesco Camarda (Lecce) is on for Nikola Stulic.

70' 3 - 0 Goal! Nikola Krstovic puts Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
68' 4:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
63' Golden chance! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
62' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
59' Alex Sala will be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
59' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) replacing Riccardo Sottil.
59' We are about to witness a substitution. Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) is replacing Mario Pasalic.
57' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
55' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
51' 2 - 0 Goal! Nikola Krstovic pulls the ball back for Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Wladimiro Falcone punches the ball away.
43' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

42' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
39' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
37' 1 - 0 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the right side of the goal. He makes it 1:0.
37' There's an opportunity for Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
36' Alex Sala (Lecce) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
34' The possession of the ball – 57:43.
30' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Gianluca Manganiello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

28' What a chance that is! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
28' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) meets a cross inside the box, but Wladimiro Falcone wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
27' Fine attempt! Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
26' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle as Isak Hien (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
24' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
23' A pass by Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
22' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes it short.

22' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
21' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
21' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atalanta, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Tete Morente (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
18' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
16' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
14' Atalanta work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
13' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Tete Morente (Lecce) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
10' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) takes the corner with a short pass.
8' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
6' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Gianluca Manganiello interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
5' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
1' The first half has started.
Lecce will kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello is introduced as the referee for today's match.
